company: A Good Sweep Chimney & Masonry Service

reviews.text: I have been using Antrim’s A Good Sweep Chimney & Masonry Service annually for many years and highly recommend. I have had my chimney cleaned and inspected every year and have also had chimney repairs done.
reviews.author: Emily O.

reviews.text: Huge thanks to Nathan from A Good Sweep! We’ve been using this company since 2013, and they always deliver. Nathan did an amazing job cleaning our fireplace insert and installing our new blower fans.
reviews.author: Paul L.

reviews.text: I am extremely satisfied with this company. Their chimney cleaning removed significant buildup, the masonry repair restored the chimney beautifully, and the fireplace inspection was comprehensive.
reviews.author: Gerard Y.
